reviews.text: The girls are great. It was a great experience with my poodle. They have exclusive and classy accessories.
Very nice and clean shop. Exceptional staff. Our puppy was groomed for the first time and was pampered so much, and the results are excellent! We're very happy! Highly recommended!

Dirty puppy makeover tutorial: Petin's bath is amazing! After the bath, it's completely transformed into a new marshmallow, and it's super gentle on dogs too.

The tutorial for rinfrescare the cagnolino sporco: I prodotti per il bagno di Petin sono fantastici! Dopo il bagno diventa proprio come una nuvola di zucchero filato nuovo, e sono molto delicati per il cane.

I had a really good experience. The woman is excellent, very attentive and helpful, and you can tell she puts a lot of care into what she does. The place is also very beautiful and welcoming.
Plus, they have a lot of unique accessories that are hard to find, especially in Milan.
Highly recommended!

I took my poodle to a groomer who did a terrible job, cutting him uninvited, and even giving him the wrong cut.
At the end of July, I happened to pass by Petin's shop. I saw a beautiful, well-kept, clean, and inviting environment, and I decided to book a grooming appointment for Bernie.
Today I took Bernie to the groomer, and I have to say I'm really pleased with the work they did; he came back looking beautiful and well-groomed.
I'm really happy; I've finally found my Pet Spa!
Well-maintained shop with very kind and knowledgeable staff. My dog ​​always leaves here looking beautiful!

Excellent experience! Kindness, care, and cleanliness. My poodle had a terrible haircut and a lot of knots, and they managed to fix it perfectly! I looked at several places in Milan, but this was definitely the best. <3
I brought my poodle after 3 days he had a skin problem I took him to my vet he told me that he was treated with poor quality products and very scratchy brushes a disaster

Sofia and the red-haired girl are always kind and professional. I highly recommend bringing your dog or cat, especially if they're a little fearful. I assure you, they'll be happy to come back next time!
Brought Arthur to the wash today. He doesn't like being touched by strangers and he let himself be washed. They are the best and I recommend them to everyone.
Simply the perfect grooming. In a wonderful place, you find kindness, care, attention, precision, and beauty. It exceeded my expectations; I'm so happy to have found impeccable professionals.
I'm Floki's owner. I had my son Matteo help me write this review. I'm so happy with the perfect grooming. My poodle has never been so beautiful! Kindness is the watchword at this dog spa! ❤️

This is my second time visiting Petin, and I truly think it’s the best pet salon in Milan.

The staff are always warm, attentive, and easy to communicate with. They genuinely care about the dogs and pay great attention to every detail. After every grooming session, my dog stays clean and smells fresh for almost a month, which really impresses me.

I also love the atmosphere of the shop. It’s beautifully designed, comfortable, and welcoming. I even bought a dog raincoat here, and I was pleasantly surprised by its quality and stylish design.

Highly recommended to anyone looking for professional and caring grooming services for their pets!
Hi Anya, thank you so much 🐾 …

I traveled all the way from Switzerland to have my dog ​​Shaï groomed, and the result is impeccable!

I'd never been satisfied before, until today at Petin Pet Spa & Boutique.

I highly recommend going there.
Positive experience!

I went to Giuseppe with Macia, 5 stars all the way, professional, empathetic, punctual.
Macia, who hates water, was very calm.
Well done.
Hi Massimo, thanks for the 5 stars! See you soon from Petin 🐾 …
Hi Mina, thanks so much for your vote! See you soon from Petin 🐾 …
Hi Nicoletta, thanks for the 5 stars! See you soon from Petin 🐾 …

This shop is a real gem!
The accessories and toys are unique compared to those found in other chains.
Sofia, who took such loving care of Ringhio and provided a magnificent grooming experience, is incredibly talented.
You've become Ringhio's second home!
Great experience, super kind girls, the product is beautiful, they were very kind in giving me advice!

Sofia is a very sweet, empathetic, and incredibly caring person. She welcomed our little Kobe, a 6-month-old puppy, with truly special sensitivity and attention.

She gave us the opportunity to bring him to the salon before his appointment, allowing him to settle in calmly and feel comfortable. Since it was his first bath, she took all the time necessary to get to know him, reassure him, and treat him with extreme gentleness, respecting his pace and emotions.

When we returned to pick him up, we found a puppy who was not only clean and beautiful, but above all calm, happy, and full of enthusiasm. The best sign? Kobe didn't want to leave! 🥰

Thank you so much, Sofia, for making his first experience so positive and special. It's rare to meet professionals who work with such passion, love, and attention to animals. We couldn't be happier ❤️🐶
Hi Anna, thank you so much 🐾 …

The best dog groomer in Milan! Ever since discovering Petin it is the only place that I take my dog Rocky for his haircuts. I know that every time he will be in good hands and taken well care of. So grateful for the people at Petin 🙏 …

Thank you so much for taking such good care of Chiquito and, above all, for treating him with so much love, patience, and kindness. Both he and I felt very welcome and well cared for. He came back looking great, perfectly clean, and smelling amazing.

Also, my Italian is still not very good, so I really appreciate that you spoke English with me and made everything so easy. It made me feel much more comfortable.

Thank you again for your professionalism and for the wonderful treatment

I took my dog ​​here for grooming and was very pleased. The wash was done carefully, the fur was clean and smelled nice, and the products used seemed to be of good quality. Plus, the shop is very cute and full of interesting pet items. A positive experience, I recommend it!
The cleaning was excellent, and the service was superb! Highly recommended! I'll definitely give them my full support!
My, you are very beautiful, Thank you so much for the professional grooming service ❤️

I met PETIN because my mom and aunt brought their toy poodles to her for grooming, and they spoke highly of Sofia. So today I took my Labrador, Ciccio, for a good wash! I was very satisfied... he was well-groomed, well-combed, and with super soft fur! We will definitely be back to Sofia and her dog!
